column1: # Per-project coverage FLOORS for the qci host gate (taxonomy-aware).
# Format (tab-separated):  project<TAB>floor_percent<TAB>note
#   project      matches the coverage artifact label in gate_host:
#                  qdistro              -> host/qdistro-coverage.json
#                  qdchrome-extension   -> host/qdchrome-extension-coverage.json
#                  qdfirefox-extension  -> host/qdfirefox-extension-coverage.json
#   floor_percent integer minimum line-coverage %% required to PASS the gate.
#                 0 == report-only (never blocks); a positive value BLOCKS the
#                 gate when the measured coverage is strictly below it.
# RATCHET, NOT A CLIFF: each positive floor is set a few points BELOW the value
# measured on current main (date in the note), so the gate is green today and
# only fails on a regression. Raise a floor toward the measured value as the
# suite stabilises.
# TAXONOMY-AWARENESS (see ci/TAXONOMY.md): the floor is meant to measure
# real_backend / fake_backend *behavioural* coverage and EXCLUDE
# source_invariant suites (which execute no product code and would otherwise
# dilute or inflate the number). In the current pipeline this separation is
# achieved STRUCTURALLY rather than by parsing categories out of the coverage
# JSON: the qdistro coverage artifact is collected ONLY over `tests/unit`
# (pytest --cov in gate_host), i.e. the in-process unit/fake_backend suites; the
# source_invariant qdwin meson "tests" and the real_backend VM bats suites run
# in *separate* gates that produce NO coverage JSON and therefore cannot move
# this number. The extension coverage is likewise collected only over the vitest
# run. LIMITATION: the coverage JSON carries no per-test taxonomy label, so a
# finer fake-vs-real split within tests/unit is not available here; the floor is
# applied to the whole tests/unit coverage number. Documented so it is not
# mistaken for a per-category measurement.
# project
qdistro
column3: measured 88.38%% (41661/47140 lines, 265 files) over tests/unit on 2026-06-11 (batched --cov-append, all batches green); floor set ~8pt below as a ratchet to absorb batch-order/env variance. Raise toward 88 as the suite stabilises.

column1: qdchrome-extension
column3: measured 83.84%% (861/1027 stmts, 19 src files) on 2026-10-10 (npx vitest run --coverage --coverage.reporter=json; 275 tests pass) with vitest 5.0.3. Rebased onto the vitest 5 bump: vitest 4+ removed coverage.all and counts statements at a finer granularity, so identical tests measure ~8pt lower than vitest 1 (was 93%%/85 floor); vitest.config.js pins coverage.include=src/** so untested src files still enter the denominator at 0%% and executed tests/ helpers stay out. floor set ~8pt below measured as a ratchet. Raise toward 84 as the suite stabilises.
